method.first: First prepare of this fixture in this process; setup and earlier fixtures can warm engine/OS caches. Not a cold-OS measurement.
method.identity: Exact var_to_bytes SHA256 of entire return, with IDs, tokens, manifest, errors and types retained. No fields removed or normalized.
method.order: first ON, warm ON twice, warm OFF three times; quick only first ON. Reference runs after measured calls.
method.scope: CPU candidate preparation, no GPU/frame time, town latency, RSS/VRAM, editor publication or traversal claim.
method.service: Unmodified real road_tools.prepare; minimal Node3D context with real WorldDocument, AuthoringView, material library and WaterwayTools. No scene publication, HTTP, save or gameplay.
method.statistics: Raw observations and median only; fixed run order cannot isolate probe cost from cache/order variation.
method.timing: External wall around prepare only; profiles copied afterwards. Input serialization, hashing, setup, evidence writes and reference excluded.
